summary: [standards] Scenario 65 says L0.contract-version judges a stream's start line and the envelope of its end line, but only the start line is seeded: removing the end-line half (mod.rs:1366-1380, the .chain of the end result) leaves the whole atip-check suite green. Behaviour is right: a fake stream whose end result lacks meta.contractVersion fails L0.contract-version alone ('(a stream): meta has no contractVersion'), checked by hand with a wrapper. Fix: add a fake-tool setting that strips the marker from the end line and a seeded case. Blast radius: streaming commands' end envelope. Not blocking.
